title: Kenworth T610 SAR Hi-tensile Aluminium FUPS Bullbar #50
description: Kenworth T610 SAR FUPS high tensile aluminium Bullbar. Three main, one piece 76mm cross tubes through drilled uprights and recessed into drilled outer uprights (optional 88 or 100mm tubes on request). Driving light mount to suit application. provision for lower front marker lights and optional lower flap. 88mm wide hi-tensile box uprights (option 100mm on request). Front mudflap mounts are standard. High tensile aluminium backing plate with 38mm tow pin. Hella indicator repeater lights in main channel. Custom "Wombat Flap" fitted below the main bar. Bull bar can be custom built to your specifications.
